00030 /**
00031  * @brief               Open a .hxui file
00032  *
00033  * This function opens a .hxui file to be used by the other HxResFile
00034  * functions.  
00035  *
00036  * This function will search multiple folders based on the active
00037  * LC_MESSAGES locale as set by a call to setlocale().  The search
00038  * order starts with the full locale name, then strips off any
00039  * character set value, then strips off the country code.  For
00040  * example, if your LANG environment variable was set to "es_ES.utf8"
00041  * and you had called setlocale(LC_ALL, "") to set the locale based on
00042  * the environment, and you passed in "/test/foo.hxui", it would first
00043  * look in "/test/es_ES.utf8/foo.hxui", then "/test/es_ES/foo.hxui",
00044  * then "/test/es/foo.hxui", and finally "/test/foo.hxui" before
00045  * giving up.
00046  *
00047  * The same resource file should not be opened more than once at a
00048  * time in a single application.  This can cause problems with
00049  * reserving ID numbers and error messages output on stderr.
00050  *
00051  * You are allowed to call this API before calling HxUiInit, but you
00052  * should not try to create any UI objects using the resource file
00053  * until the UI system has been initialized.
00054  *
00055  * @param pFilename     IN: name of the .hxui file, relative to the current directory.
00056  *                      This file is opened with read-only permissions.
00057  * @param hResFile      OUT: a handle to the resource file
00058  *
00059  * @return HxResult:    Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00060  *                      HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.  Returns
00061  *                      HX_MISSING_FILE if the filename is invalid.  Returns
00062  *                      HX_FAILURE for other failures.    
00063  **/
00064 HxResult HxResFileOpen (const char* pFilename, HxResFile_t **hResFile);
00065 
00066 /**

00069  * This function treats a NULL-terminated in-memory buffer as a .hxui
00070  * file.  This lets you parse .hxui data that is embedded in a program
00071  * or read from a non-file source.  The buffer must remain valid until
00072  * the HxResFile_t object is closed.
00073  *
00074  * You are allowed to call this API before calling HxUiInit, but you
00075  * should not try to create any UI objects using the resource file
00076  * until the UI system has been initialized.
00077  *
00078  * @param pBuffer       IN: pointer to NULL-terminated character buffer holding the .hxui
00079  *                      file contents to parse.
00080  * @param pDirectory    IN: pointer to pathname to use as root directory for any file
00081  *                      references seen in the .hxui buffer.  If NULL, use current directory.
00082  * @param hResFile      OUT: a handle to the resource file
00083  *
00084  * @return HxResult:    Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00085  *                      HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.  Returns
00086  *                      HX_FAILURE for other failures.    
00087  **/
00088 HxResult HxResFileOpenBuffer (const char* pBuffer, const char *pDirectory, HxResFile_t **hResFile);
